chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: Going overseas with Sammy Price and George Wein
summary: He tries to recall whether his first trip to Europe was with Sammy Price or the Newport All-Stars, and a solo trip to play in London.

blocks.x: Yeah. (Inaudible). I even went over the hill with Sammy.
